name: Grimsby
doing: watching the world go by on a bench in the Gouden Griffelplantsoen
thought: The ink is fading, but the words are still sharp.

feeling.words: Sunlight on the tiles. A single drop of water hangs from the gutter. I count it. It’s the third one today.
